scope: Read-only community/design research; no app source edit, build or deployment in this turn.

search.note: Candidate counts are not full-text reviews. Supplemental domain-targeted web searches filled Reddit and X coverage gaps.

selectionCriteria: Original creators with real work or interactive examples
Transferable to a student-rental three-panel map product
Visible change in composition/material/motion, beyond generic hover fades
Separate source observations from proposed adaptations

sources.title: I Built a Design System — So Why Does My Website Still Feel Outdated?
sources.evidence: full page and comment section read
sources.quality: An individual critique thread. Comments disagree; not a survey or conversion study.
sources.finding: Some commenters identify repeated boxes, weak type hierarchy and generic imagery as the problem; others favor more color. A token system alone does not establish an art direction.

sources.title: Opinion on scroll-triggered sliding/fading elements
sources.quality: Practitioner and visitor anecdotes, mixed positions. No controlled usability study.
sources.finding: Comments distinguish narrative/delight from frequent utility work. Repeated fades that hide information or interrupt scanning attract criticism.

sources.title: Between Print and Digital: The Making of MERSI’s Website
sources.evidence: original studio case study read; linked live site visited and project clicked
sources.quality: First-hand studio account with detailed transition implementation. Promotional and award-oriented, not student-rental conversion evidence.
sources.finding: Architecture-book composition, materiality, strong photography, split images and cover-to-detail continuity establish identity.

sources.title: Spain Collection: Evolving a Luxury Website into a Digital Ecosystem
sources.quality: First-hand travel-design account. Luxury travel audience differs from students.
sources.finding: Editorial typography and curated photography give character; familiar filters and linked modal detail views keep discovery understandable.

sources.title: A Linear spin on Liquid Glass
sources.quality: Shipped native iOS implementation from product team. Its shader code is not a direct web drop-in.
sources.finding: Material comprises blur, a supporting gradient, highlight and shadow. Team explicitly omits refraction for dense professional UI readability.

sources.title: Designing Depth
sources.quality: Practitioner explanation with composition and choreography examples; qualitative design reasoning.
sources.finding: Foreground/background relationships, de-emphasis and staged reveal communicate spatial depth.

sources.title: Good vs Great Animations
sources.evidence: original essay read; live clip-path tabs clicked
sources.quality: Practitioner interactive demos. Author also sells a course; public article supports the cited techniques.
sources.finding: Origin-aware expansion, easing and synchronized tab/text transitions improve continuity.

sources.title: 7 Practical Animation Tips
sources.quality: Public practical examples by author, not empirical benchmark.
sources.finding: Immediate press feedback, brief UI transitions and localized blur can smooth state changes.

sources.title: Jakub Krehel: Interfere sidebar between two layers
sources.evidence: MotionVault archive text read; original X URL returned 403
sources.quality: Secondary archive only. Do not claim original post/video, popularity or full animation was directly verified.
sources.finding: Archive describes a navigation-layer transition; useful discovery pointer only, not independent proof of the exact effect.

sources.title: How we built Interfere’s new website
sources.evidence: original team article read, cross-checked from social discovery
sources.quality: First-hand visual identity and engineering breakdown by product team. Marketing-site examples require adaptation.
sources.finding: Explores many complete directions before defining signature details. Translucency, repeated brand gradient and grouped animation establish coherence.

sources.title: Motion layout animations
sources.finding: layoutId supports shared-element transitions; layoutScroll and layoutRoot address scroll/fixed-container measurement.

sources.title: GSAP Flip
sources.finding: Candidate tool for complex measured layout transitions; not proposed as an additional mandatory library.

sources.title: View Transition API
sources.quality: Technical reference; browser support must be checked for actual implementation
sources.finding: Candidate progressive enhancement for view-to-view continuity, with a regular-navigation fallback.

sources.title: CesiumJS Camera
sources.evidence: official documentation opened and existing city-map.tsx inspected
sources.quality: Primary technical source plus current project code
sources.finding: Use current engine's camera API for framing transitions; existing flyToBoundingSphere already animates focus, so merely adding flyTo again is not a redesign.

browserChecks.actions: Viewed home composition; clicked Hamelin and observed destination page.
browserChecks.limitation: Still screenshot does not establish frame rate or capture complete animation.

browserChecks.actions: Clicked Balances in clip-path tabs demo.
browserChecks.limitation: State change verified; no frame-time measurements. One embedded 3D video reported media unavailable.

browserChecks.actions: Read and captured current public UI without changing app state.

accessLimits: Original X status returned HTTP 403. MotionVault archive used only as a discovery pointer; no original video viewing or engagement claim.
Case studies provide qualitative inspiration, not evidence that the proposed direction will improve student-rental conversion.
